title: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment
objectives: TODO: 2 sentences in your own words (read Description on the PSI page)
approach: SPICE (Smoke Point In Coflow Experiment) burned gaseous-fuel jet flames (ethylene, methane, propane and propylene, some as 75% and 50% blends) in a controlled coflow of air in the fan-driven duct of the ISS Microgravity Science Glovebox. Nozzle size, fuel flow rate and air velocity were varied to find when the flame starts to emit soot. The experimental table lists the conditions of 147 flames over 11 test days; the smoke-point and flame-length results are in separate PSI-107 files. Soot and smoke output of gas flames in microgravity is relevant to smoke production for fire detection.
